item.title: Marc Jacobs Answers the Proust Questionnaire
item.description: The consummate New York City designer, Sofia Coppola documentary subject, and recovering Labubu collector on his signature manicures, love for The Great Gatsby, and Edith Piaf–inspired motto.

item.title: Stellan Skarsgård Wanted to Save the World. He’ll Settle for Being an Oscar Nominee
item.description: The star of Sentimental Value goes long on his career, the key to Mamma Mia’s success, and the advice he does (and doesn’t) give his many children.

item.title: See The Adorable Letter The Future Queen Elizabeth Sent to Her Housekeeper on Vacation
item.description: A newly discovered letter, written when Elizabeth was 10 years old, shows off her love for animals, artistic talent, and kindness to her staff.

item.title: Chelsea Clinton: In a Time of US Retreat, Dr. Paul Farmer’s Legacy Calls Us to Stand Up
item.description: Four years after Farmer’s death, Clinton reflects on preserving her mentor’s lifework in health care and remembers his tender tenacity.

item.title: From the Queen’s Tweeds to Kate Middleton’s Zara, Justine Picardie Reveals the Soft Power of Royal Dressing
item.description: Picardie, author of Fashioning the Crown: A Story of Power and Couture, explores the influence and importance of the royal wardrobe in her new book.

item.title: Rose Byrne and Kristen Wiig Toast to 'Bridesmaids', Friendship, and Launching Themselves Into Space
item.description: The stars of If I Had Legs I’d Kick You and Palm Royale reunite 15 years after the release of their raunchy comedy to reminisce about auditions, strip clubs, and stretching themselves: “If you’re not a little bit scared, then maybe reexamine what you’re doing.”

item.title: Queen Camilla Meets Gisèle Pelicot at Clarence House: “Your Story Has Left Me Speechless”
item.description: Pelicot wrote A Hymn to Life: Shame Has to Change Sides, a gripping memoir about her escape from marital sexual violence that Queen Camilla said she read in just two days, telling the author, “I couldn’t put it down.”

item.title: Can the Monarchy Survive the Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor Scandal?
item.description: “The longer it goes on, the more damaging it will be for the institution,” royals historian Ed Owens tells Vanity Fair of what he calls “the biggest crisis since the abdication of Edward VIII in 1936.”

item.title: Kelly Klein: The Muse Who Shaped '90s Fashion With Her Friend Carolyn Bessette Kennedy
item.description: Twenty years after divorcing Calvin Klein, Kelly Klein is getting another turn in the spotlight thanks to her character being on American Love Story.

item.title: Trump’s State of the Union: Hockey Champions and Grisly Tales of Bloodshed
item.description: In the longest ever State of the Union address, President Trump camouflaged his claims of a historic economic boom in star-spangled spectacle as his approval ratings dip deep underwater.
